[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 240
- Description: Security incident response — transcript repo privacy, fine-grained PAT redaction, crontab + log exposure cleanup
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/421
  
  Details:
  SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE — leaked PAT exposure, containment, and cleanup.
  
  BACKGROUND / FINDING
  - 8 distinct FULL 93-char fine-grained GitHub PATs (github_pat_…) were found in plaintext in local session logs (/opt/truesight_autopilot/sessions/*.json, *_debug.log, *.pre-compact-*.json) across 40+ files. Fingerprinted via sha256^12 against the .env vault: TRUESIGHT_DAO_AUTOPILOT, sentiment_importer rows B/C, KRAKE_IO_PAT, KRAKEIO_LLM_PLAYGROUND_PAT, GITHUB_READ_PAT, plus 2 unidentified vault PATs.
  - No public URL: the raw logs were never published (verified 404 on raw.githubusercontent). Diagnosis per SOPHIA rule 11 — the absolute paths in the errors were local to the autopilot box, not a remote host.
  
  ACTIONS TAKEN (all verified)
  1. Repo privacy — PATCH'd TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot_transcript to private. Pre-flight: 0 forks, no GitHub Pages site, no CNAME, so nothing public broke. Anonymous read 404 (was 200). Publish path restored after the governor granted GITHUB_TRANSCRIPT_PAT access to the private repo; verified a real publish landed (commit c3ea3dacfe6a, PUT 201 / DELETE 200).
  2. Redaction fix — PR #421 (merged): added a `github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{22,}` rule to _REDACTION_PATTERNS in app/main.py. The redactor previously covered only classic ghp_/gho_/ghs_/ghu_/ghr_ tokens — a total blind spot for the fine-grained PAT format this deployment actually uses. Added 4 unit tests. CI green (3/3). NOTE: merged to main but NOT yet deployed to the box.
  3. Crontab — the 30-min sync_pending_caches job carried a raw GITHUB_TOKEN=github_pat_… (fingerprint 373b9dd51697, same as .env). Replaced with a read from .env (single source of truth; no new secret copy). 0 plaintext tokens remain in the crontab. Proved the job still works under `env -i /bin/sh` (exit 0, real pushes, correct fingerprint).
  4. Session logs — scrubbed 40 files / 242 occurrences in place, with a 700-mode backup for rollback. Verified 0 residual tokens and 706/706 JSON files still parse.
  5. Log surfaces — verification surfaced a larger, uncatalogued leak: cron logs each job's full command line, so syslog held ~1,128 full token copies. Scrubbed in place (rsyslog stopped to avoid a race, sed redaction on plain files, zcat|sed|gzip on archives) and journald (journalctl --rotate + --vacuum-time=1s; 82M -> 14.8M). Total ~1,179 copies removed across 8 surfaces, all verified to 0. Services (rsyslog, cron, systemd-journald) healthy; sync job green after.
  
  STILL OPEN (governor-owned, deliberately untouched)
  - Token rotation — the only true cure; parked at the governor's request.
  - Deploy of PR #421 — the redaction fix is not live until a deploy.
  - Rollback copies still hold tokens: scrub_backup_20260910T034453Z (240 tokens) and crontab.bak.20260910T035415Z (1 token) — awaiting a delete OK.
  
  EVIDENCE
  - PR: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/421 (merge sha 2e055b37bc84b02b222b7b18437d6fee9fdf227f)
